Written composition rubrics are original practice rubrics. Accept equivalent meaningful forms after examiner checking; no fixed national mark allocation inferred.

All fictional letter dates, school names, addresses, book loans and visits are practice only. No historical examination content or copied university exercise.
Other Igbo tables, source terminology, mixed phonetic notation, counting-range conflict and school language choice/adoption remain unresolved.
